info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Accounts Management API
info.description: The Accounts Management API enables businesses to effectively manage customer accounts within the system. This endpoint allows for the removal of specific accounts associated with a customer, supporting organizations in maintaining accurate customer account information. It serves as a critical tool for applications where account lifecycle management is necessary. Typical consumers include financial institutions and any service providers that require account deletion for compliance and operational efficiency.

delete.summary: Remove a specific account associated with a customer.
delete.description: This operation allows you to delete a specific account (ACC-200045) linked to a customer (CUST-100045). Ensure that this account is no longer needed, as this action is irreversible and will result in the permanent deletion of the account's associated data.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to specify the parameters for deleting the account associated with customer CUST-100045 and account ACC-200045. Ensure that the necessary identifiers are provided correctly to execute the delete operation successfully.

204.description: Request completed successfully; the resource was deleted.

DeleteCustomerAccountRequest.description: This schema represents the request body format for deleting an account associated with a specific customer.

DeleteCustomerAccountResponse_204.title: Delete Account Response
DeleteCustomerAccountResponse_204.description: This schema represents the response structure for the DELETE operation on an account.

ResponseMetadata.title: Response Metadata

responseId.description: A unique identifier for the response.

correlationId.description: An identifier used to trace the request across different services.

generatedAt.description: The timestamp indicating when the response was generated.

processingRegion.description: The region in which the request was processed.

ResponseMetadata.description: This schema contains metadata about the API response.

bearerAuth.description: This security scheme uses HTTP bearer authentication, which requires the use of a token in the Authorization header. The token expected is in the JSON Web Token (JWT) format, which allows for secure transmission of claims between parties.
